Description: Member / patient / client full name (e.g. Member Name)
Member date of birth (Member DOB)
Texas Medicaid ID, 9 digits; may be labelled Member ID or Health Plan ID
Health plan / payer, e.g. Molina, Superior, Amerigroup (often only in letterhead)
Authorization / referral / prior-auth number (e.g. Reference#, Auth #)
Service authorized, e.g. Non-Waiver PAS Agency Model, Personal Attendant Services
HCPCS service code with modifier, e.g. S5125 U5
Authorized HOURS with the period, e.g. 29 hrs per week (not units)
First day the authorization is effective (Start Date / Begin Date)
Last day the authorization is effective (End Date)
Diagnosis description or reason for services
Member home address
Member phone number (not the coordinator's or provider's)
ICD-10 diagnosis code, e.g. I10
Authorized units per week (15-minute units), e.g. Frequency / Total Units Per Week
Total units authorized for the whole authorization period
Service code modifier, e.g. U5 (Modifier 1)
Authorization / line status, e.g. Approved, Pended, Denied
Payer case ID, e.g. LTSS-########
Payer's service coordinator for the member
Service coordinator email
Approved / purchased tasks list, e.g. bathing, dressing, meal prep
Date the payer reviewed / decided the authorization
Service coordinator phone
Primary care physician (PCP) name
Primary care physician phone
